thread:
anya: quick sync — we need to lock pilot scope for the mobile batching heuristics. field teams want something we can ship to two customers in 2 sprints. thoughts? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sam: can we be specific about constraints? p99 latency target, token savings goal, and which quant profiles to try.
rachel: from customer side — both pilot customers are on unstable networks and low-device RAM. main ask = fewer cold-starts and lower per-call cost. they can tolerate small output variance.
matt: ok. that implies aggressive quantization + client-side caching hints. risk: some models degrade on 4-bit for longer contexts. need evals per prompt-set.
lucy: support ticket volume for one customer spiked last month when we switched to higher-batch windows. we should avoid increasing tail errors.
sam: proposal: MVP = adaptive batching (socket->batch window 30ms default, max 100ms), prefix KV caching for repeated requests, and 8-bit quant profile for short contexts; fallback to 16-bit for long context or high-regression prompts.
anya: that seems reasonable. what are acceptance criteria for pilot success?
matt: measurable ones: 1) median latency <= baseline+10% for single-request flows, 2) token cost reduction >= 25% on pilot traffic, 3) eval-concordance drop <= 2% on golden prompt set.
rachel: also add operational: no more than 1 SE escal per week during pilot and runbook updated.
sam: rollout plan: feature flag + canary on 10% of traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 48h windows. if eval-alert fires, auto-rollback to baseline.
matt: for eval-alerts, suggest thresholding on 1) perplexity delta, 2) ngram overlap, 3) domain-specific classifiers. quick config example for alerts:
```
alert_config:
  eval_sets: [mobile_ui, payment_flows]
  metrics:
    - name: concordance
      threshold: 0.98
    - name: latency_p99
      threshold: baseline_p99 * 1.2
  actions:
    - notify: #optimize-ops
    - rollback: true
```

lucy: +1 to auto-notify and rollback. who owns the runbook?
anya: ops + eng runtime co-own. sam, can you draft the runbook checklist (observability queries, rollback steps, customer comms)?
sam: yep. will drop a PR by EOD tomorrow.
rachel: i can coordinate the two customer pilots (AcmeMobile, NimbusApp). will get their traffic profiles and golden prompt sets.
matt: we should also include quant fallback test cases — small set of prompts that historically fail with 4-bit. i'll add them to eval harness.
anya: scope shrink option if we run out of time: drop KV caching and ship batching + alerts first. cheaper to iterate.
sam: agree. batching + eval-alerts gets most bang for effort. caching can be v1.1.
lucy: will prepare support playbook and template customer message.
deploybot: deploy scheduled: feature-flag scaffolding merged to staging at 1745010200.
anya: next steps recap: sam -> runbook PR; matt -> add quant-fallback evals; rachel -> customer traffic + golden prompts; lucy -> support playbook; we'll reconvene Fri to lock launch gate. :calendar:
